# VibeFix — The 24/7 Self-Healing DevOps Engine for AI Builders

> VibeFix is an autonomous DevOps and error-healing engine designed for applications built with AI coding tools (Cursor AI, Lovable.dev, Bolt.new, v0 by Vercel, Windsurf, Claude Artifacts).

## Core Capabilities
- **24/7 Background Error Catching**: Detects uncaught runtime exceptions, 500 errors, and broken webhook payloads in production before customers leave.
- **Isolated Sandbox Reproduction**: Re-runs the failing execution trace in a headless sandbox to verify root causes without risking live production databases.
- **AST-Level Minimal Patching**: Generates clean, minimal code diffs that fix edge cases without rewriting entire files or hallucinating dependencies.
- **1-Click GitHub Pull Requests**: Hands founders a verified, tested pull request ready to merge and deploy in under 60 seconds.

## Supported Stacks
- Frameworks: Next.js (App Router / Pages Router), React, Vite, Node.js, Remix, Astro.
- Platforms: Cloudflare Pages & Workers, Vercel, Supabase, Render, Railway.
- Coding AI Tools: Cursor, Lovable.dev, Bolt.new, v0, ChatGPT, Claude Code.

## Quickstart
1. Install client: `npm install @vibefix/client`
2. Connect repository on [https://vibefix-landing.pages.dev](https://vibefix-landing.pages.dev)
3. Zero-configuration auto-patching is active.
